name: ACN-Data (Caltech Adaptive Charging Network)
content: EV charging sessions at Caltech (54 EVSEs), JPL (50-52) and an office site (8): connection, done-charging and disconnect times, kWh delivered, station ID, and for claimed sessions the user-entered requested departure and kWh.
time_span: From 2018, updated with about a 2-week delay
license: No formal license; cite the e-Energy 2019 paper
how_useful_for_coster: A capacity-limited resource where each arrival declares a planned departure (a noisy plan). Test 'plan vs learned correction' of outflow timing and exceedance alerts on a fixed slot count, mirroring Coster's planned vs realised production/shipments.

name: Carreras warehouse public event tables (phononautomata/warehouse)
content: Public derived tables from one month of a large Spanish logistics warehouse: inventory-arrival timestamps, shelf-racking timestamps, and outbound-buffer pallet entry/exit timestamps with anonymised flow labels and sojourn times. IDs, locations, volumes and weights were removed.
size: Per paper Table S1: 1,403 inbound buffer arrivals, 26,352 shelving events, 13,325 outbound buffer arrivals, 3,601 outbound departures
how_useful_for_coster: Ready-made arrival + departure + sojourn data for prototyping the 'arrivals + length of stay' occupancy reconstruction and Monte Carlo of log-normal sojourns. The data shows weekly-cycle effects (weekend build-up, Monday clearing). It covers one short window, like Coster's post-August history.

name: fev-bench datasets (autogluon/fev_datasets)
content: 100 forecasting task configs (96 unique datasets). 46 tasks have covariates (30 with known-future dynamic covariates). Retail (Favorita, Rossmann, Walmart, M5, Rohlik), energy (ENTSO-E, EPF, solar with weather), mobility, hospital admissions, cloud. Comes with the fev evaluation library.
size: About 127,836 series rows, about 658 MB Parquet
how_useful_for_coster: Run the exact Chronos-2 + known-future-covariate + rolling-origin backtest + win-rate/skill-score pipeline on public covariate tasks. This debugs the code and sanity-checks against published results before Coster data arrives.

name: Hotel Booking Demand datasets (Antonio, de Almeida & Nunes 2019)
content: Bookings from a resort hotel and a city hotel with 31 variables: arrival date, lead time, weekday/weekend nights, cancellation flag, reservation status and status date (from hotel PMS databases).
how_useful_for_coster: Best public analogue of 'occupancy = scheduled arrivals + length of stay, with plan slips (cancellations)'. Rebuild on-the-books vs realised daily occupancy at each lead time and backtest the simulator -> residual GBM -> conformal chain and 80%/90% exceedance alerts.

name: Lineage Logistics public warehousing records (Duration-of-Stay / ParallelNet)
content: De-identified public version of pallet storage records used to predict pallet duration-of-stay (DoS). The full private data has 8,443,930 pallet records from 37 facilities. Model features included product text, arrival date and customer type.
time_span: Full data Jan 2016 - Jan 2018 (public subset span not stated)
size: Full data 8,443,930 pallet records; public subset size not stated
how_useful_for_coster: Largest known public source for learning pallet length-of-stay distributions conditioned on product and customer. It fits the outflow side of the simulator for pallets without a planned consumption date (e.g., finished goods waiting to ship). Per the paper, request it from the authors by email. Availability is uncertain.
check_note: Independent check: confirmed. arXiv 1903.05063 PDF confirms 8,443,930 records from 37 facilities (2016.1-2018.1), product text/arrival date/customer type features, and a de-identified public version obtainable by email.

name: SupplyGraph benchmark dataset
content: 41 products with temporal features for production, sales orders, deliveries to distributors and factory issues (units and metric tons). Graph edges link products by product group, sub-group, plant (25 classes) and storage location (13 classes).
granularity: Per date (exact granularity not stated on pages checked)
how_useful_for_coster: A short (about 7 months) real multi-product series of production in vs issues/deliveries out, similar in length to Coster's usable history. Use it to test the flow-balance rung, whether sales orders lead outflows, and grouping by plant/storage location.

name: Temporal Logistics & Inventory Movements (VillanovaAI, Hugging Face)
content: Event-level WMS stock movements: plant/warehouse, area, aisle, position and cell (plus destination fields after transfers), movement cause code and in/out sign, piece quantities, lot/container/handling-unit IDs, document and shipment references, operator, dates and times. Field names (stab, maga, cors, posi, cell, caus, segno) and the date format '09-gen-24' suggest an Italian WMS (our inference; the card does not name the source).
time_span: Not stated on card (example date in 2024)
how_useful_for_coster: Closest public analogue to a WLog movement log at cell level. Use it to build and test the parser, pandera schemas and the 'rebuild daily occupancy per location from signed movements' logic, plus reconciliation against snapshots, before Coster exports arrive. Access is gated: you must agree to share contact info on Hugging Face.

name: BPI Challenge 2019 (purchase order handling)
content: Purchase-order handling at a multinational coatings and paints company: purchase documents, items, goods receipt and invoice events. Four flow types (3-way match with invoice after/before GR, 2-way, consignment). Values are linearly transformed.
license: Not clearly stated (4TU terms; check before use)
how_useful_for_coster: Real PO-creation -> goods-receipt delays at item level. Fit receipt-delay and partial-delivery distributions for purchased material inflows (Coster POs are 5-6 weeks ahead) and feed them into the simulator's Monte Carlo slips.

name: City of Melbourne On-street Car Parking Sensor Data (2019; 2020 Jan-May)
content: In-ground sensor events per CBD bay: arrival and departure times, the bay's parking restriction and whether the vehicle overstayed.
size: 2019: about 42.7M rows (717.1 MB compressed); 2020: about 14.2M rows (258.5 MB)
how_useful_for_coster: A large slot-level arrival/departure log. Practise rebuilding occupancy from events, fitting length-of-stay by restriction type (like load-unit type) and counting 'no compatible free slot' moments per zone.

name: Comprehensive Daily LPG Distribution Dataset (IEEE DataPort)
domain: Distribution depot inventory with returnable containers
content: Daily records (25 variables): opening and closing filled-cylinder inventory, cylinders received from the plant, deliveries, stockout indicators, empty-cylinder collection and dispatch, pricing and festival-period flags, across godown and showroom.
how_useful_for_coster: Daily stock = opening + receipts - deliveries, with returnable empties. This mirrors Coster's metal containers that come back empty and still need a cell. Good for testing the flow-balance identity and calendar (festival) covariates. Real vs synthetic is not stated. DOI 10.21227/k6wq-st68.

name: Conveyor Blockages at a Food Logistics Warehouse (IEEE DataPort)
domain: Warehouse inbound conveyors feeding stacker cranes (food, Spain)
content: Box-level inbound arrival stream ordered for replay: timestamp, SKU, inbound conveyor lane and the list of stacker cranes available at that time. Contributed by Corporación Alimentaria Guissona / University of Lleida.
how_useful_for_coster: Real, bursty inbound stream into a crane-served automated warehouse. Use it to stress-test the simulator's inflow generator and crane/LGV capacity assumptions. Requires an IEEE DataPort subscription. DOI 10.21227/e3b2-q809.

name: Event Log Dwelling Time Dataset (container terminal)
content: Event log of the import-container dwell process (unloaded from ship to gate-out) from a terminal information system. It has case ID, activities and timestamps, plus worker, waiting time and cost attributes. Partly anonymised.
time_span: 3 months of dwell activity (extracted over 6 months)
license: Not stated on Mendeley page (Data in Brief article is open access)
how_useful_for_coster: Length-of-stay analogue for storage units in a capacity-limited yard. Fit dwell-time distributions and rebuild yard occupancy from in/out events to test the simulator's sojourn module.

name: Inventory Management Database and OCELs (RWTH PADS, simulated)
domain: Synthetic ERP inventory / object-centric event log
content: SQLite DB with materials, plants, sales orders, purchase requisitions/orders, goods receipts/issues, material stocks, material documents and order suggestions. Derived OCELs track running stock levels before and after each event, plus understock/overstock status events (EOQ, safety stock, reorder point).
how_useful_for_coster: Sandbox with known ground truth for the 'snapshot + open POs/production orders - open sales orders' rung. Join documents to goods receipts/issues, compare projected vs realised stock, and test pandera checks on SAP-like tables.

name: NHS England Daily UEC Sitrep - G&A and Critical Care Beds
content: Daily returns from acute trusts. Adult and paediatric G&A beds split into core and escalation beds, adult critical care, PICU and neonatal beds, and patients with length of stay 7+, 14+ and 21+ days.
time_span: 2020-21 to 2025-26 datasets; time series Mar 2020 - Nov 2025
how_useful_for_coster: Daily occupancy by bed class with an explicit overflow layer (escalation beds, like Coster's floor buffer) and long-stay counts. Use it to pre-train/backtest per-class occupancy forecasts and 80%/90% alerting over years of history.

name: Order Picking Dataset from a Warehouse of a Footwear Manufacturing Company
content: Real WMS SQL extracts from a footwear manufacturer's warehouse: Cartesian-mapped storage locations, aisles, depots, product classifications, storage positions, picking waves, routes, timestamps and operator data, plus CAD layouts and Python scripts. Anonymised.
license: Article CC BY-NC 4.0; Mendeley license field blank
how_useful_for_coster: Template for a WMS location-master + movement data model and for testing storage-assignment logic (class-based vs random). It is weak for occupancy forecasting because inbound flows are not the focus.

name: Parking Birmingham (UCI)
content: Car park ID, capacity, occupancy and timestamp for NCP-operated Birmingham car parks, 08:00-16:30 daily.
how_useful_for_coster: A tiny, clean occupancy-vs-capacity panel of about 2.5 months, similar to Coster's post-August history. Good for first notebooks: persistence and seasonal baselines, Chronos-2 zero-shot, conformal bands and P(occupancy > 80%/90%) across parallel capacity-limited units (like cell classes).
check_note: Independent check: confirmed. UCI page confirms NCP Birmingham car parks, 08:00-16:30, 4 Oct-19 Dec 2016, 35,717 instances, CC BY 4.0 (source data OGL).

name: Spatiotemporal Bikeshare System Status (Capital Bikeshare, MSOM data set)
content: Nearly minute-by-minute available bikes and open docks per station for Washington DC's Capital Bikeshare, cleaned and linkable to official trip records (inflows/outflows).
how_useful_for_coster: Many capacity-limited units with explicit in/out flows and 'station full' events (like 'cell class full'), over 3+ years. Use it to backtest alert logic and pre-train a residual model over many parallel units. Access via the DOI online appendix (not tested).

name: Bosch Production Line Performance (Kaggle)
content: Anonymised measurements, categorical and date features per part across 51 stations on 4 lines, with a binary failure label. Date features encode when each part passed each station (about 6-minute resolution, weekly periodicity).
size: About 14.3 GB; 1,184,687 train + 1,183,748 test parts; about 3,100 features
how_useful_for_coster: Station timestamps allow reconstructing WIP/flow between stations as a buffer analogue. The data is huge and anonymised, so use it only if a large production-flow test set is needed.

name: Chronos datasets (autogluon/chronos_datasets)
content: 67 Parquet subsets (energy, weather, finance, transport, retail incl. m5, dominick, monash_car_parts), plus the Chronos training corpus: about 10M TSMixup augmentations and about 1M KernelSynth synthetic series.
size: 67 subsets; training configs about 8.56M and 875k rows
how_useful_for_coster: Shows what Chronos has already seen (relevant to leakage claims). KernelSynth/TSMixup-style augmentation can enlarge Coster's short post-August series if fine-tuning is tried.

name: Container Logistics Object-centric Event Log (OCEL 2.0)
content: Artificial OCEL 2.0 log from a coloured Petri net: 14 event types and 7 object types (Container, Transport Document, Customer Order, Truck, Forklift, Vehicle, Handling Unit). Includes the CPN simulation model.
how_useful_for_coster: Practice object-centric modelling (pallet <-> order <-> LGV <-> cell) for the movement log, and DES-style replay. Synthetic, so it is not useful for model accuracy.

name: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding (Mendeley)
content: Production orders by date, machine, shift and product with 30+ variables: production targets, unit weights, cycle/cooling times, cavities, defects, flash waste, total production time, materials and process settings (from PLCs, scales and an MES).
how_useful_for_coster: Prototype the conversion of a moulding plan (target qty, cycle time, cavities, scrap) into expected pallets per hour entering the AW, the main inflow driver for Coster's 38 presses.

name: DataCo Smart Supply Chain for Big Data Analysis
content: DataCo Global supply chain records across provisioning, production, sales and distribution (clothing, sports, electronics), plus an unstructured clickstream log and a variable description file. The order-level shipping-time fields reportedly include scheduled vs real shipping days; check this against the description file.
how_useful_for_coster: Useful only for prototyping plan-slip distributions (scheduled vs actual shipping time) to drive Monte Carlo of shipment timing. No stock data.

name: Dublin Bikes Historical Station Data (Smart Dublin)
content: GBFS-style station status: station ID, capacity, bikes available, docks available, renting/returning flags, location and last_reported timestamp. Published as monthly files.
how_useful_for_coster: Easy-to-load capacity/occupancy panel for testing the per-unit fill-ratio forecasting and alert code. Lower value than Capital Bikeshare because it has no trip flows.

name: GIFT-Eval and GiftEvalPretrain (Salesforce)
content: GIFT-Eval: 23 datasets, about 144k series, about 177M points, 7 domains, 10 frequencies. GiftEvalPretrain: 88 datasets (71 univariate, 17 multivariate), about 4.5M series, about 230B points, split to avoid test leakage.
how_useful_for_coster: Reference leaderboard for choosing a foundation model. Use the pretrain corpus only if the team fine-tunes a model and must avoid leakage.

name: M5 Forecasting (Walmart) dataset
content: 30,490 daily product-store unit-sales series for 10 stores in 3 US states. Calendar events, weekly sell prices and SNAP flags as explanatory variables. Hierarchical (item, department, category, store, state); mostly intermittent.
how_useful_for_coster: Known-future covariates plus a hierarchy analogous to material -> cell class -> AW total. Use it to test hierarchical reconciliation and LightGBM residual models. Also available without Kaggle login via fev_datasets m5 configs.

name: MIMIC-IV (hosp module: admissions, transfers) and MIMIC-IV demo
content: De-identified EHR data from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. The hosp module has admissions and intra-hospital transfers between care units; the icu module has ICU stays. Dates are shifted per patient. The demo has 100 patients and is open access.
license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (demo: ODbL 1.0)
how_useful_for_coster: Unit-level census with transfers between unit types, like moves between cell classes or defrag. Good for testing a class-cascade occupancy simulator with length-of-stay sampling. Full access needs CITI training and a DUA; start with the open demo.

name: Production Analysis with Process Mining Technology (Levy, 4TU)
content: Tabular manufacturing workflow records with case and activity IDs, resources, timestamps and other fields.
how_useful_for_coster: Small real production log for practising the conversion of MES events into pallet-creation times (inflow to the AW). Limited otherwise. DOI 10.4121/uuid:68726926-5ac5-4fab-b873-ee76ea412399.
check_note: Independent check: confirmed. 4TU record confirms Dafna Levy's CSV production process log (case, activity, resource, timestamp), DOI 10.4121/uuid:68726926-..., 4TU General Terms of Use.

name: SAPiBench synthetic S/4HANA-oriented inventory benchmark
content: 100-item material master (lead time, costs, seasonality type) and 7 years of synthetic daily demand, plus generator script and notebook. The notebook covers forecasting baselines and inventory simulation (safety stock, reorder point, EOQ).
size: Demand file 12.22 MB; material master 6.71 KB
how_useful_for_coster: Synthetic SAP-like material master and generator for unit tests of the ingestion and inventory simulation code. The generator is on GitHub; the data files on IEEE DataPort need a subscription. It does not model storage cells.

name: SFpark Parking Sensor Data - Hourly Occupancy 2011-2013
domain: On-street parking occupancy with price changes
content: Hourly block-level occupancy from the SFpark demand-responsive pricing pilot, plus a data guide and a list of blocks by rate adjustment.
how_useful_for_coster: Test whether known-future covariates (scheduled price changes) help Chronos-2 / LightGBM on occupancy, a stand-in for Coster's known future plans.

name: Benchmark Instances for Manual Warehouse Order Picking (KIT RADAR)
content: Synthetic instances: warehouse layout graphs, article-to-location storage assignments and order streams with due dates and arrival volatility. Two designs (OFAT 32 settings x 100 reps; LHS 100 sets x 100 reps) plus example routing/waiting solutions.
how_useful_for_coster: Little direct use. Possibly a source of order-stream generators for simulator tests. Layouts are NetworkX pickle files, so load them only in an isolated environment (pickle can execute code). DOI 10.35097/mwsv59v8sk9sqaan.

name: COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility (HHS, via data.gov)
content: Weekly (Fri-Thu) facility-level hospital capacity and patient-impact fields with _sum/_avg/_coverage suffixes, including previous-day admission counts. The full field list is in columns.json (bed fields not checked here). Values below 4 are suppressed.
how_useful_for_coster: Many parallel capacity-limited units with admissions as inflow. Only useful for pre-training or stress-testing exceedance alerts. Weekly granularity is coarse.

name: Italian Civil Protection COVID-19 data (pcm-dpc/COVID-19)
content: Daily national, regional and provincial COVID-19 monitoring data from the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile, in CSV/JSON. The regional schema includes hospitalised patients (ricoverati_con_sintomi, totale_ospedalizzati), ICU patients (terapia_intensiva) and daily ICU admissions (ingressi_terapia_intensiva).
how_useful_for_coster: Daily stock (patients in ICU) + inflow (admissions) for 21 Italian regions under capacity stress. Pre-training/backtesting of threshold-crossing probabilities. Verify field names before use.
check_note: Independent check: corrected. Repo confirms CC-BY-4.0, CSV/JSON, national/regional/provincial levels; the field doc lists ricoverati_con_sintomi, terapia_intensiva, totale_ospedalizzati and ingressi_terapia_intensiva, so the 'not checked' caveat can go.

name: Managing Pod Replenishment (IEEE DataPort)
content: Stockout-pod and item-storage data from a robotic forward-reserve warehouse, used for an optimisation algorithm (MMEA).
how_useful_for_coster: Negligible. Optimisation instances, not operational time series.

name: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive
content: 25 publicly available datasets from varied domains with different frequencies, lengths and missing values, evaluated with standard baselines on ten error metrics.
how_useful_for_coster: Generic baseline sets only. Lower priority than fev-bench because few tasks have covariates.

name: NHS England KH03 Bed Availability and Occupancy
content: Quarterly total available and occupied bed days by consultant main specialty, overnight and day-only, from all NHS organisations operating beds. A historical beds time series covers 1987-88 to 2009-10.
time_span: Historical series from 1987-88; quarterly KH03 since 2010-11
how_useful_for_coster: Too coarse for 1-14 day forecasting. At most useful for illustrating capacity-utilisation benchmarks per class.

name: OCEL 2.0 Order Management simulated log
content: Simulated object-centric order-management log (XML/JSON/SQLite) from the OCEL standard site.
how_useful_for_coster: Toy order -> shipment timing data for unit tests of the outflow side. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8337463.

name: OCEL 2.0 Procure-to-Pay simulated log
content: Simulated object-centric procure-to-pay log (XML/JSON/SQLite) from the OCEL standard site.
how_useful_for_coster: Toy data for PO -> goods-receipt lead-time pipelines. BPI 2019 is the better, real alternative. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8412919.

name: OCEL Hinge Production (sustainability-enriched, simulated)
content: Small simulated object-centric production log (a few thousand events) for a hinge manufacturing process.
how_useful_for_coster: Minor use: a manufacturing OCEL example for designing the MES -> pallet-creation event schema. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13638681.

name: Supply Chain Logistics Problem Dataset (Brunel)
content: Seven tables: historical order list with routing, freight rates, plant-port links, products per plant, VMI customers, warehouse capacities (max orders/day) and storage cost per unit.
how_useful_for_coster: Only for capacity-constrained allocation toy problems (e.g., testing a cascade/LP allocator). Not a time series of stock.

name: The order set for the study of item storage assignment problem in RMFS (Mendeley)
content: Customer order sets at four warehouse scales: 1,000 orders/10 SKUs up to 1,000,000 orders/500 SKUs (.mat files).
how_useful_for_coster: Not relevant to unit-load AS/RS occupancy. Listed for completeness.

name: Time-300B (Time-MoE pretraining corpus)
content: Large multi-domain pretraining corpus on Hugging Face, including sales subsets (dominick, favorita_sales, favorita_transactions, hierarchical_sales, m5, monash_car_parts, restaurant). The paper is referenced by arXiv 2409.16040.
size: n>1T size category; sales folder 109 MB
how_useful_for_coster: Not needed unless pretraining. Note that the Hugging Face page flags 1 file as unsafe, so download selectively.

name: Warehouse dataset (synthetic, IEEE DataPort)
content: Synthetic storage-location records (generated with Gretel.ai, following a TI Supply Chain API storage-locations structure): IDs, X/Y coordinates, storage capacity, capacity status and utilisation rate.
how_useful_for_coster: Negligible. A static synthetic location table with no flows.
